topics.title: Speed, Time & Distance
topics.summary: Master relative speed, trains crossing platforms/poles, and boats & streams.

formulas.name: Unit Conversion
formulas.rule: Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × (5/18); km/h = m/s × (18/5)

formulas.name: Average Speed
formulas.rule: If a distance is covered at x km/h and returned at y km/h, Avg Speed = 2xy / (x + y)

formulas.name: Trains Passing Pole
formulas.rule: Time to cross stationary point object = Length of Train / Speed of Train

formulas.name: Trains Passing Platform
formulas.rule: Time to cross platform of length P = (Length of Train + P) / Speed of Train

formulas.name: Relative Speed
formulas.rule: Same direction: S1 - S2; Opposite direction: S1 + S2

formulas.name: Boats & Streams
formulas.rule: Downstream Speed = u + v; Upstream Speed = u - v; Boat speed u = (D + U)/2; Stream speed v = (D - U)/2

questions.question: A train 240 m long passes a pole in 24 seconds. How long will it take to pass a platform 650 m long?
questions.explanation: Speed of train = Length / Time = 240 / 24 = 10 m/s. Total distance to cross platform = 240 + 650 = 890 m. Time required = 890 / 10 = 89 seconds.
questions.shortcutTrick: Direct formula: Total time = (Train Length + Platform Length) / Speed = (240 + 650)/10 = 89s.

questions.question: A man covers a certain distance by car at 60 km/h and returns to starting point at 40 km/h. What is his average speed for the whole journey?
questions.explanation: Average speed for equal distances = 2xy / (x + y) = 2 × 60 × 40 / (60 + 40) = 4800 / 100 = 48 km/h.
questions.shortcutTrick: Harmonic mean: 2 × 60 × 40 / 100 = 48 km/h. Never take the arithmetic mean (50) for equal distances!

questions.question: A boat can travel with a speed of 13 km/h in still water. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the time taken by the boat to go 68 km downstream.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = Boat speed + Stream speed = 13 + 4 = 17 km/h. Time = Distance / Speed = 68 / 17 = 4 hours.
questions.shortcutTrick: Downstream speed is always (u + v). 68 / 17 = 4 hours directly.

questions.question: Two trains 140 m and 160 m long run at speeds of 60 km/h and 40 km/h respectively in opposite directions on parallel tracks. What is the time taken to cross each other?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 140 + 160 = 300 m. Relative speed in opposite direction = 60 + 40 = 100 km/h = 100 × (5/18) = 250/9 m/s. Time = 300 / (250/9) = 300 × 9 / 250 = 10.8 seconds.
questions.shortcutTrick: Time = (L1 + L2) / (Relative Speed in m/s) = 300 / (100 × 5/18) = 10.8 seconds.

topics.title: Percentages & Profit/Loss
topics.summary: Cost price, marked price, successive discounts, and profit-loss percentages.

formulas.name: Profit & Loss %
formulas.rule: Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100; Loss % = (Loss / CP) × 100 (always calculated on CP)

formulas.name: Successive Percentage Change
formulas.rule: Net change = a + b + (ab / 100)%

formulas.name: Successive Discounts
formulas.rule: Equivalent single discount for d1 and d2 = [d1 + d2 - (d1 × d2 / 100)]%

formulas.name: Dishonest Dealer
formulas.rule: Gain % = [Error / (True Value - Error)] × 100

questions.question: An article is sold for ₹840 at a profit of 20%. What was the cost price of the article?
questions.shortcutTrick: 20% profit = 1/5 profit. So SP is 6/5 of CP. CP = 840 × (5/6) = 700.

questions.question: A shopkeeper offers two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on an item. What is the net single discount percentage?
questions.shortcutTrick: Let initial = 100. After 20% off = 80. After 10% of 80 off = 80 - 8 = 72. Total discount = 100 - 72 = 28%.

questions.question: If the cost price of 12 pens is equal to the selling price of 8 pens, find the gain percentage.
questions.shortcutTrick: Direct formula: [(Goods bought - Goods sold) / Goods sold] × 100 = [(12 - 8)/8] × 100 = 50%.

topics.title: Time & Work
topics.summary: Work efficiency, combined work, pipe and cistern problems.

formulas.name: One Day Work
formulas.rule: If A can finish work in n days, A's 1 day work = 1/n

formulas.name: Combined Work (A + B)
formulas.rule: Time taken together = (A × B) / (A + B) days

formulas.name: Efficiency Ratio
formulas.rule: Time ratio is inverse of efficiency ratio: Time_A / Time_B = Eff_B / Eff_A

formulas.name: Pipes & Cisterns
formulas.rule: Inlet pipe adds (+1/n), Outlet pipe empties (-1/m). Net = (1/n) - (1/m)

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 12 days and B can do it in 15 days. How long will they take to complete the work together?
questions.explanation: LCM of 12 and 15 = 60 units. Efficiency of A = 60/12 = 5 units/day. Efficiency of B = 60/15 = 4 units/day. Combined efficiency = 9 units/day. Time = 60 / 9 = 20/3 = 6.67 days.

questions.question: 15 men can complete a project in 10 days working 8 hours a day. How many men are needed to complete the same work in 5 days working 6 hours a day?

topics.title: Number System & LCM/HCF
topics.summary: Divisibility, unit digit cycles, remainders, and prime factorization.

formulas.name: LCM × HCF Property
formulas.rule: LCM(a, b) × HCF(a, b) = a × b

formulas.name: Unit Digit Cyclicity
formulas.rule: Digits 2, 3, 7, 8 have cyclicity of 4; Digits 4, 9 have cyclicity of 2; Digits 0, 1, 5, 6 have cyclicity of 1.

formulas.name: Divisibility by 11
formulas.rule: (Sum of odd place digits - Sum of even place digits) must be 0 or divisible by 11.

formulas.name: Sum of First n Naturals
formulas.rule: Sum = n(n + 1) / 2; Sum of squares = n(n + 1)(2n + 1) / 6

questions.question: What is the unit digit of (7^95 - 3^58)?
questions.explanation: 7 cyclicity is 4. 95 mod 4 = 3 => 7^3 = 343 => unit digit is 3. 3 cyclicity is 4. 58 mod 4 = 2 => 3^2 = 9 => unit digit is 9. Unit digit = (13 - 9) = 4.

questions.question: The HCF of two numbers is 11 and their LCM is 7700. If one of the numbers is 275, find the other number.
questions.explanation: Product of numbers = HCF × LCM => 275 × Other = 11 × 7700 => Other = (11 × 7700) / 275 = 84700 / 275 = 308.

topics.title: Logical Reasoning & Syllogisms
topics.summary: Deductive reasoning, blood relations, direction sense, and series completion.

formulas.name: Direction Sense
formulas.rule: Turning right = 90° clockwise; Turning left = 90° counter-clockwise. Distance = √(x² + y²)

formulas.name: Blood Relations
formulas.rule: + for male, - for female; = for spouses; | for child/parent relationship

formulas.name: Syllogism Rules
formulas.rule: All A are B + All B are C => All A are C; Some A are B != All B are A

questions.question: A man walks 5 km East, then turns right and walks 12 km. How far is he from his starting point?
questions.shortcutTrick: Recognize Pythagorean triplet: (5, 12, 13). Answer is 13 km instantly.

questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, Rohit said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is Rohit related to the girl?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son = Rohit's father. Daughter of Rohit's father = Rohit's sister. So Rohit is her brother.
questions.shortcutTrick: Break backwards: 'grandfather's only son' = Father. 'daughter of Father' = Sister. Therefore, Rohit is Brother.

topics.title: Data Interpretation (DI)
topics.summary: Tables, bar charts, pie charts, percentage growth and ratio analysis.

formulas.name: Percentage Growth / Increase
formulas.rule: [(Final Value - Initial Value) / Initial Value] × 100

formulas.name: Pie Chart Angle Conversion
formulas.rule: Angle = (Value / Total Value) × 360°; 1% = 3.6°

formulas.name: Ratio Comparison Shortcut
formulas.rule: If a/b and c/d: cross multiply ad vs bc. If ad > bc then a/b > c/d
